description.value: The study investigated whether early-phase [18F]florbetapir PET can provide pseudo-FDG information comparable to FDG-PET in behavioural variant frontotemporal dementia and distinguish bvFTD from Alzheimer’s disease and cognitively normal controls.

spans.text: The current investigation tested the feasibility of using florbetapir as a dual-phase biomarker in behavioural variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD).

description.value: An observational diagnostic imaging study of bvFTD patients, cognitively normal controls, and AD patients; bvFTD patients underwent both florbetapir and FDG PET, while controls and AD patients underwent florbetapir PET only.

spans.text: Eight bvFTD patients underwent [18F]florbetapir and [18]FDG-PET scans. Additionally, ten healthy controls and ten AD patients underwent florbetapir-PET only.
